definitions.explanation: A type of insurance where premiums are paid but no money is returned if no claim is made during the coverage period. The premiums are essentially "thrown away" if the insured event does not occur.

examples.japanese: {掛|か}け{捨|す}て⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{保険|ほけん}→保険：01509_hoken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: I signed up for term insurance.

examples.japanese: {掛|か}け{捨|す}て{型|がた}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{保険料|ほけんりょう}→保険料：11058_hokenryou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{魅力|みりょく}→魅力：03749_miryoku⟧だ。
examples.english: The appeal of the non-refundable type is that the premiums are low.

examples.japanese: ⟦{貯蓄|ちょちく}→貯蓄：18972_chochiku⟧{型|がた}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{掛|か}け{捨|す}て{型|がた}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{保険|ほけん}→保険：01509_hoken⟧、⟦どちら→どちら：00927_dochira⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{迷|まよ}っている→迷う：02426_mayou⟧。
examples.english: I'm torn between savings-type and term-type insurance.

notes:
Literally means "pay and throw away" — from {掛|か}ける (to pay/wager) and ⟦{捨|す}てる→捨てる：00892_suteru⟧ (to throw away). Refers to insurance policies where premiums are not refunded if the policy term ends without a claim. The trade-off is lower monthly premiums compared to savings-type policies.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {掛|か}け{捨|す}て{型|がた}: non-refundable type (insurance)
- {掛|か}け{捨|す}て⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{保険|ほけん}→保険：01509_hoken⟧: term/non-refundable insurance
- {掛|か}け{捨|す}て⟦{保険|ほけん}→保険：01509_hoken⟧: term insurance
- {掛|か}け{捨|す}て⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to go with the non-refundable option

INSURANCE TYPES:
- {掛|か}け{捨|す}て{型|がた}: term (non-refundable) — lower premiums, no cash value
- ⟦{貯蓄|ちょちく}→貯蓄：18972_chochiku⟧{型|がた}: savings type — higher premiums, builds cash value
- ⟦{積立|つみたて}→積立：07977_tsumitate⟧{型|がた}: accumulation type — similar to savings type

- ⟦{生命保険|せいめいほけん}→生命保険：18637_seimeihoken⟧: life insurance
